description: This is a Python source file implementing a client SDK for RAG Evaluation, including classes for evaluation results, evaluator classes for synchronous and asynchronous operations, and utility functions for evaluation.

classes.name: EvaluationMode
classes.description: Enum for evaluation depth modes: quick, standard, thorough.

classes.name: Domain
classes.description: Enum for domain categories: general, medical, legal, financial.

classes.name: FaithfulnessResult
classes.description: Data class for faithfulness evaluation results.

classes.name: RelevanceResult
classes.description: Data class for relevance evaluation results.

classes.name: HallucinationResult
classes.description: Data class for hallucination detection results.

classes.name: ConstitutionalResult
classes.description: Data class for constitutional evaluation results.

classes.name: RAGEvaluationResult
classes.description: Data class aggregating all evaluation metrics and results.

classes.name: RAGEvaluator
classes.description: Main class providing methods to perform various RAG evaluations synchronously.

classes.name: AsyncRAGEvaluator
classes.description: Async version of RAGEvaluator for asynchronous operations.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Performs full RAG evaluation with all metrics.

methods.name: evaluate_quick
methods.description: Performs quick evaluation for real-time validation.

methods.name: evaluate_standard
methods.description: Performs standard evaluation suitable for production.

methods.name: evaluate_thorough
methods.description: Performs thorough evaluation for audits or compliance.

methods.name: faithfulness
methods.description: Evaluates faithfulness of response using adversarial debate.

methods.name: relevance
methods.description: Evaluates relevance of response using multi-jury consensus.

methods.name: hallucination
methods.description: Detects hallucinations in responses using hybrid ML+LLM.

methods.name: constitutional
methods.description: Evaluates response against principles-based constitutional criteria.

methods.name: sample_and_evaluate
methods.description: Samples logs and evaluates for quality metrics.

methods.name: _parse_full_result
methods.description: Parses API response into RAGEvaluationResult object.
